meta.name: lark-openapi-explorer
meta.description: 飞书/Lark 原生 OpenAPI 探索：从官方文档库中挖掘未经 CLI 封装的原生 OpenAPI 接口。当用户的需求无法被现有 lark-* skill 或 lark-cli 已注册命令满足，需要查找并调用原生飞书 OpenAPI 时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找并调用飞书原生 OpenAPI 接口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在飞书平台上使用官方文档中未封装的 API。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and call Lark native OpenAPI endpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use undocumented Lark OpenAPI from official docs.

howto.what: 当现有飞书技能或CLI命令无法满足需求时，Claude会从飞书官方文档中查找原生OpenAPI接口，并通过lark-cli api命令直接调用。
howto.when: 当用户提出的飞书操作需求没有被现有lark-*技能或lark-cli已注册命令覆盖时触发。

say.text: 帮我拉人进群，但CLI没有这个命令。
say.note: Claude会从文档挖掘拉人进群的API并调用。

say.text: 设置群公告，但lark-cli没有相关命令。
say.note: Claude会查找设置群公告的API并执行。

howto.what_en: When existing Lark skills or CLI commands cannot fulfill a request, Claude searches the official Lark documentation for native OpenAPI endpoints and invokes them directly via lark-cli api.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user's Lark operation requirement is not covered by existing lark-* skills or registered lark-cli commands.

say_en.text: Add members to a chat, but CLI has no such command.
say_en.note: Claude will find the API and call it.

say_en.text: Set the group announcement, but lark-cli has no related command.
say_en.note: Claude will find the API and execute it.
